goal: Log in with the provided username and password, so that the Secure Area page is shown.
notes: Type the username into the Username field, the password into the Password field, then press the Login button.

checks.logged_in: A green flash message says 'You logged into a secure area!'
checks.on_secure_page: The page heading says 'Secure Area' and a Logout button is visible
checks.login_error: A red flash message says the username or password is invalid

logged_in.when: The page heading says 'Secure Area' and a green flash message says 'You logged into a secure area!'

bad_credentials.when: A red flash message says the username or password is invalid
bad_credentials.note: these are the demo site's valid credentials; rejecting them is a defect

server_error.when: An error page, a stack trace or 'something went wrong' text is shown instead of the login form or the secure area

assert.text_contains: You logged into a secure area!
